# Canva

> Canva's partner ecosystem enables developers and agencies to integrate with a comprehensive visual design platform.

Canva is a visual design platform offering a suite of tools including presentations, social media design, photo editing, video creation, websites, forms, resumes, logos, and collaborative features like whiteboards and documents. The partner program connects third-party developers and agencies with Canva's API and integration opportunities.

## Key Topics

- Canva Visual Suite
- Design Tools
- Partner Directory
- Integration Partners
- Email
- Presentations
- Social Media Design
- Photo Editor
- Videos
- Websites
- Forms
- Whiteboards
- Docs
- Sheets
- Logos

## Partner Ecosystem

- [Find a Canva Partner](https://partners.canva.com/): Directory to discover and connect with trusted Canva integration partners and agencies.
